description:
Get one cake order you sent: its status, who it goes to, the delivery photos and what it cost.
Use for: checking where a cake order stands after send_cake. It only reads the stored order: it never asks the vendor, sends the order again or moves money.
Not for: ordering a cake (send_cake).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_cake_order({"orderId":"cake_3f9a0c1e2b4d5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f80"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: get_cake_order

charge.description: What the order took from your wallet: price + fee.

actions.description: send_cake: the order ended without a cake and the charge is back in your wallet; send again with a new idempotencyKey. get_cake_status: the order was charged but never sent to the vendor; call get_cake_status with this order id to send it on, and do not send it again with a new key. Left out otherwise.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

deliveryDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Left out when the order named no date.

deliveryPhotoUrls.description: Photos of the delivered cake. Left out until there are any.

status.description: placed: the vendor has the order. pending: your wallet was charged, but delivery is unconfirmed. Sending or payment may still need completion. Contact support with order.id if it stays pending. Do not send again with a new key. delivered. delivery_failed: the charge is being returned. refunded: the vendor refused the order or delivery failed, and the charge is back in your wallet.

title: Get a cake order
